vulnerabilities.title: argument injection in git_diff via unsanitized target passed to git CLI
vulnerabilities.description: the target parameter is passed directly to repo.git.diff() without validation, so a flag-like value such as --output=/path/to/file is interpreted as a git option rather than a ref, enabling arbitrary local file overwrite (CVE-2025-68144)

vulnerabilities.title: arbitrary filesystem path in git_init allows repository creation anywhere
vulnerabilities.description: the git_init tool passes repo_path straight to git.Repo.init(path=repo_path, mkdir=True) with no validation, so it can create a .git repository at any path the server process can reach, including sensitive directories like ~/.ssh (CVE-2025-68143)
